faqs.q: Does pressure washing damage roof shingles in Orange, NJ?

runs.v: Yes. Per ARMA, it causes granule loss and premature failure of the roof system.

faqs.q: What removes the dark streaks on a roof in Orange?

runs.v: If you notice dark streaks, the ARMA bleach-and-water wash removes the algae buildup behind them.

faqs.q: Does moss cause roof leaks on Orange homes?

runs.v: Yes. Moss traps moisture and interferes with water shedding; severe moss buildup sends water to the roof deck, causing leaks and long-term damage, per ARMA.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to clean a roof in Orange?

runs.v: No construction permit is needed for cleaning, which is maintenance; confirm with the City of Orange Township construction office, as historic-district properties can need extra review.

faqs.q: Do zinc or copper strips prevent roof moss and algae in Orange?

runs.v: Zinc and copper inhibit algae growth, per ARMA, but ARMA advises against adding strips to an existing roof because the exposed nails cause leaks.
